quarterly_data.quarter: SK Hynix IR presentation: Q2 2026 results (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results deck: SK Hynix concluded around 10 long-term agreement (LTA) negotiations including key customers and is continuing discussions with other major industry players; the LTAs carry pricing structures designed to address price volatility (varying by customer and product) and financial mechanisms such as deposits to support contract fulfillment, which the company says enhances mid-to-long-term demand visibility.
quarterly_data.figure: around 10 LTAs concluded, including key customers

quarterly_data.quarter: SK Hynix IR presentation: Q2 2026 results (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results deck: SK Hynix began HBM4 shipment in Q2 2026 (the company cites customer-required speeds, industry-leading power efficiency and cost competitiveness), with full ramp-up planned in 2H 2026; it supplied 1cnm-based HBM4E samples to a major customer in 1H 2026 and fully commenced supply of 1cnm-based SOCAMM2 products.
quarterly_data.figure: HBM4 shipment began Q2 2026; full ramp-up planned 2H 2026; 1cnm HBM4E samples to a major customer in 1H

quarterly_data.quarter: SK Hynix IR presentation: Q2 2026 results (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results deck, capacity: SK Hynix is pulling in M15X mass production and accelerating capacity expansion at Yongin Fab1 in early 2027, with phased mid-to-long-term investments in P&T7, M17 and new domestic semiconductor clusters based on customer demand and investment efficiency. Market view: robust demand growth amid constrained supply conditions; major Big Tech customers are expanding infrastructure investment and memory procurement due to AI service growth and a shortage of computing capacity; the deck notes a temporary adjustment in sales due to challenges in securing memory volumes, with growth momentum expected to recover gradually as supply tightness eases.
quarterly_data.figure: M15X mass production pulled in; Yongin Fab1 capacity expansion accelerated to early 2027

quarterly_data.quarter: SK Hynix IR presentation: Q2 2026 results (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results deck: DRAM bit growth high-single-digit % QoQ with ASP up approx. 30% QoQ; NAND bit growth mid-teen % QoQ with ASP up mid-50% QoQ; operating margin 76%, a record-high quarterly OPM, on DRAM and NAND price increases and cost improvement; EBITDA KRW 64.56T (81% margin); net profit margin 118% as other non-operating profit of KRW 60.89T included investment-asset-related gains of KRW 63.27T.
quarterly_data.figure: DRAM B/G high-single% QoQ, ASP approx. 30% QoQ; EBITDA KRW 64.56T (81% margin); investment-asset gains KRW 63.27T
